params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
Set-Location $repo
git fetch origin --prune
$branches=@(
'agent/bridge-uia-native-20260929',
'agent/control-test-narrow-test-scope-only-build-a-r-20260928133350-vrokm',
'agent/launch-observation-atomicity-20260928',
'agent/swarm-contract-v3-20260929-0540',
'agent-bridge',
'codex/complete-mod-workflows'
)
$out=@()
foreach($b in $branches){
 git show-ref --verify --quiet ("refs/remotes/origin/"+$b)
 if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){$out += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$b;state='missing'};continue}
 $tip=(git rev-parse ("origin/"+$b)).Trim()
 $unique=@(git log --format='%H|%ad|%s' --date=iso-strict ("origin/main..origin/"+$b))
 $files=@(git diff --name-only ("origin/main...origin/"+$b))
 $out += [pscustomobject]@{branch=$b;tip=$tip;unique_count=$unique.Count;unique_commits=$unique;files=$files}
}
[pscustomobject]@{main=(git rev-parse origin/main).Trim();branches=$out} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
